fixes.explanation: Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, is a name tied to Balaam, so I get why it came to mind. Numbers 22:4 says Balak was king of Moab, and Numbers 22:5 says he sent messengers to Balaam. But Moses doesn't name him here. He says it was "…through the counsel of Balaam…" (Numbers 31:16) So the answer is Balaam son of Beor.

Og king of Bashan is a king Israel fought and defeated earlier (Numbers 21:33, 35), but he isn't in this verse. Moses says the women caused it "…through the counsel of Balaam…" (Numbers 31:16) So the answer is Balaam son of Beor. Og can sit this one out.
